title: Continuous-function set sheaf and coefficient maps
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], in the universe convention [def-weil-size-convention], with $X$ in universe $u$ and a topological space $D$ in universe $u+1$. Define the set sheaf $F_{D,X}$ to be the continuous-function presheaf [def-sfb-continuous-set-presheaf], bundled with its sheaf property: its sections are exactly $C(|U|,D)$ and restrictions are precomposition. For another topological space $E$ in universe $u+1$ and a continuous map $h:D\to E$, define $F_{h,X}:F_{D,X}\to F_{E,X}$ on every $U$ by $s\mapsto h\circ s$. No separation, disconnectedness, compactness, discreteness or group structure is required of $D$ or $E$.

source.place: Example 3.1, p.6, continuous-function description with ring operations omitted; Bhatt--Scholze, Lemma 4.2.12, p.30, for arbitrary topological spaces.
